name: cadherin 11

function.text: CDH11 encodes cadherin-11. Annotated molecular activities include beta-catenin binding and cadherin binding. It participates in ossification and cell adhesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Elsahy-Waters syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: CDH11 can act as a promoter-donating partner in USP6 rearrangements in primary aneurysmal bone cysts. This fusion context is distinct from an arbitrary CDH11 sequence alteration.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
